title: Scott’s Tots
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael grapples with the consequences of his past promises to pay for children's college tuition, while office dynamics include misunderstandings about pregnancy, miscommunications about employee awards, and plans for manipulating colleagues. The episode features Michael’s regret over his promises, conflicts among staff, and humorous interactions that reveal character motivations and relationships.
